exemplars.paper_id: A Link Clustering Based Approach for Clustering Categorical Data
exemplars.key_insight: CDC问题与LC问题等价，两个领域的算法可以互换使用
exemplars.method_signature: 将分类数据属性等价类映射为链接，应用LC的概率生成模型聚类

exemplars.paper_id: Clustering Mixed Numeric and Categorical Data_ A Cluster Ensemble Approach
exemplars.key_insight: 聚类输出本身是类别标签,可作为类别属性处理;利用Squeezer算法支持加权属性相似度计算来解决不同子数据集的权重平衡
exemplars.method_signature: CEBMDC: 先分割数据集为纯类别和纯数值子集,分别聚类后合并为类别数据集再聚类集成

exemplars.paper_id: K-ANMI_ A Mutual Information Based Clustering Algorithm for Categorical Data
exemplars.key_insight: Treating each attribute's value partition as a clustering result allows reformulating categorical clustering as a cluster ensemble consensus problem.
exemplars.method_signature: k-means style iterative algorithm directly optimizing ANMI objective using histogram-based data structures for scalability.
